transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Um… I guess I’m here because my eating’s been getting out of hand. After work or class, I’ll sit with my laptop and end up eating a full takeout meal, then chips or sweets, whatever snacks I have in my desk drawer. It’s… a lot more than I meant to eat, and definitely more than I’d eat if someone else were there.
After these episodes of eating a large amount, do you ever try to compensate by making yourself vomit, using laxatives, fasting, or exercising excessively?
Um… I don’t really know. I mean, I don’t think I do anything like that on purpose after. I mostly just feel bad and try to move on.
During these times when you're eating more than you intended, do you feel like you can't stop eating or control what or how much you're eating?

Yeah… kind of. Once I start, it feels like I’m just watching myself keep reaching for the next thing, even while I’m thinking, like, Jaime, stop… you have work to finish, and you’re not even enjoying this anymore.
Do you feel a lot of distress or upset about these episodes of overeating?
Yeah… I mean, I don’t feel great about it. It’s embarrassing, mostly. I try not to think about it too much after.
Can you describe how long these episodes usually last? Do they happen over a short, specific period, like a couple of hours, or do they spread out more throughout the day?

It’s usually after work or class… I’ll sit with my laptop and it kind of happens all in that stretch. Like I’ll have takeout, then chips or sweets, whatever’s in my desk drawer. It’s more than I meant to eat, definitely. I don’t think it’s, like, the whole day usually.
Can you recall if, during these episodes, you feel a clear loss of control — like you’re not in charge of your eating, even though you might want to stop?

Yeah… I think so. It’s like once I start, I’m not really in charge of it anymore. I’ll be thinking, Jaime, stop, you’ve got that budget report to finish… and I just keep reaching for more anyway. Even when I’m not really enjoying it.
Can you recall if these episodes happen in a short, distinct window of time — like within an hour or two — or do they tend to drag on throughout the evening?

It’s more like one stretch, I guess. I’ll sit down with my laptop after work or class, and it kind of turns into… a takeout meal, then chips or sweets, whatever snacks I have in my desk. It’s a lot more than I meant to eat, not something I’d really do in front of other people.
How often do these episodes happen? Are they something you experience at least once a week, or do they happen less frequently?

Yeah… it’s at least once a week. When I looked back at my journal and some food delivery charges, it’s been most weeks since the restructuring started. Usually more than once a week, not just, like… every once in a while.
